description: Small oval garden pond ringed by 26 rounded edge stones, with water surface, lotus pads, two pink lotus flowers and a clump of reeds.
size_note: Approx. 5.2 x 3.8 m; water surface 0.22 m above the bed.
modeling_method: Claude pond retained with separated lotus pads and SectCore04 materials; ten references packed and ten revised renders.
geometry_revision: Separate five coplanar lotus pads to eliminate surface overlap and black render artifacts.
